 Story Links
 Navy senior running back Vic Listorti has been enjoying a career season as the Mids' lead B-Back. But this Saturday, the Pasadena native will be playing against Temple with an extra weight off of his shoulders: https://www.youtube.com/watch? v=rqSViy6C2rQ 
 Defensive tackle Griffen Willis spoke to the media on Wednesday ahead of Navy's next game against Temple. The senior has started a team-high 26 games on defense in his career: https://www.youtube.com/watch? v=HnT6xcnjgtE 
 Defensive Coordinator Eric Lewis spoke to the media on Wednesday afternoon ahead of this weekend's game against Temple. The Midshipmen play their next two games at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial Stadium: https://www.youtube.com/watch? v=MK6veGBG92I 
 Navy Football Podcast: https://www.podpage.com/navy- football-podcast/navy- football-heads-into-the-home- stretch/
